notes.title: Explore the Ancaria region!
notes.content:
Ancaria is a country comprising several nations that have had to coexist for generations. The geopolitical map has undergone several changes throughout history due to the impact of wars and the actions of rulers. Ancaria has a history of hundreds of independent kingdoms, duchies, and territories, which have been annexed by larger kingdoms through both bloody wars and negotiations that have sometimes involved humiliation. The result of this is the current political landscape of Ancaria.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45079099/ee45fc349247896187cf4c0a38165dc5d8d13b6d.jpg


 Kingdom of Valgus: 
Based on a Parliamentary Hereditary Monarchy, the King exercises the three powers (Executive, Legislative and Judicial) of the Kingdom and the Grand Council, elected by the King himself, is in charge of advising the decisions of the monarch and of administering and supervising the fulfillment of the laws in all the towns and villages that are part of the Kingdom through the election of a Mayor elected by its inhabitants. The current King is Siegfried II, known for his role in the Great War that came to freeze the conflict.


 Kingdom of Kor
An ancient state inhabited by the Enoshi race. The throne of the kingdom is occupied by King Koraj, known as The Philosopher. He is adored by the Enoshi for his public policies to collect taxes and contribute to filling the public coffers, as well as building a just society based on meritocracy. The Kingdom of Kor has always kept out of the conflicts of the continent to maintain the millenary peace that exists in the Kingdom.


 Holy See of Lyka
Neutral territory but administered and defended by the Kingdom of Kor. There is located the Great Temple where resides The Great Mother, spiritual leader of the main religion of all Ancaria, who worships Lyka, or simply Goddess, creator of the world and life.


 Principality of Dumah
Its territory is popularly known as "The Big Island". It is noted for its large deserts and high temperatures. Most of the island is uninhabited, concentrating its population in the northeastern part, in the capital of the Principality, Baladys. Its government is a hereditary monarchy, the title is called Prince or Princess. The current incumbent is Princess Asira.


 Holy Empire of Graecia
A state with a few tens of years of existence. Its origin is due to the ambition of a single man, Descitio, known by his rivals as The Fool or The Just, according to the Empire itself, was a general of the ancient Republic of Graecia. He proclaimed himself Emperor of all the western territories, giving rise to the very Empire that is known today. His foreign policy was based on the expansion of the Empire's territory, which provoked conflicts between the Principality of Dumah and the Kingdom of Valgus, marking an era known as The Great War.


 "The Void"
Popular name for the territories in dispute as a result of the Great War. The Great War was the largest war in the history of Ancaria, mobilizing all the armies of the major powers that led to a global state of war that lasted 3 years. After the armistice, the administration of different localities was divided between the Kingdom of Valgus and the Empire of Graecia. Instability is palpable in the localities, especially in the region of Yueguo, where the Empire has a strong interest in annexing it to its territory.


It's been 35 years since the Great War came to a standstill and the era known as Pax Mendaxbegan, but.... How long can the armistice hold?
